description: This file provides functions for listing files in directories with support for recursion, filtering, and integration with ripgrep and gitignore. It includes directory traversal, special directory handling, and ignore pattern management.

classes.name: ScanContext
classes.description: Interface defining context for directory scanning, including target directory status and ignore handling.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Main exported function to list files in a directory, with options for recursion and limit.

methods.name: getFirstLevelDirectories
methods.description: Retrieves immediate subdirectories of a given directory.

methods.name: ensureFirstLevelDirectoriesIncluded
methods.description: Ensures all first-level directories are included in the results, adjusting the list if necessary.

methods.name: handleSpecialDirectories
methods.description: Handles special cases for root and home directories to prevent full listing.

methods.name: getRipgrepPath
methods.description: Retrieves the path to the ripgrep binary.

methods.name: listFilesWithRipgrep
methods.description: Uses ripgrep to list files in a directory, with recursive option.

methods.name: buildRipgrepArgs
methods.description: Constructs command-line arguments for ripgrep based on directory and recursion.

methods.name: buildRecursiveArgs
methods.description: Builds ripgrep arguments for recursive directory listing, respecting ignore patterns.

methods.name: buildNonRecursiveArgs
methods.description: Builds ripgrep arguments for non-recursive directory listing.

methods.name: createIgnoreInstance
methods.description: Creates an ignore instance that respects .gitignore files from directory up to root.

methods.name: findGitignoreFiles
methods.description: Finds all .gitignore files from a starting directory up to the workspace root.

methods.name: listFilteredDirectories
methods.description: Lists directories with filtering based on ignore patterns and limits.

methods.name: execRipgrep
methods.description: Executes ripgrep command and processes output to list files.
